name: Pepper v Hart [1992] UKHL 3 – Hansard
summary: House of Lords permitted reference to Hansard (parliamentary debates) when interpreting ambiguous legislation. Overturned prior exclusionary rule. Courts may look at ministerial statements on the purpose of legislation. Significant impact on UK statutory interpretation methodology.
